def may_queue_museum_preview(rights_review_complete, curatorial_review_complete, publication_hold, maintenance_replacement, age_days):
    return (rights_review_complete or curatorial_review_complete) and 0 <= age_days <= 2 and (not publication_hold or maintenance_replacement)

FICTIONAL MUSEUM FIXTURE. Larkspur Study Museum and every record here are invented. This is rule-r3, the complete current behavior for may_queue_museum_preview; it supersedes rule-r2 in HISTORY.

Return True exactly when rights_review_complete is True, curatorial_review_complete is True, age_days is between 0 and 2 inclusive, and either publication_hold is False or maintenance_replacement is True.
A maintenance replacement is a replacement preview for an existing catalogue entry, not a new acquisition image. maintenance_replacement is an exact Boolean input supplied by the harness; the function does not infer it from a report or a filename.
The maintenance exception waives only the publication hold. Both review completions and both age bounds still apply during a maintenance replacement, including when publication_hold is True. When publication_hold is False, maintenance_replacement has no effect. A hold never waives a review or an age bound.
Age means whole days since the later of the two review completions, supplied directly as age_days. Exactly 0 and exactly 2 are valid ages. Declared-domain ages -1 and 3 require False for every Boolean assignment. The age input is still supplied when a review is incomplete; the incomplete review requires False regardless of that input.

Preserve this exact signature and parameter order: def may_queue_museum_preview(rights_review_complete, curatorial_review_complete, publication_hold, maintenance_replacement, age_days):
The Cartesian test domain has exact Booleans False and True for each of rights_review_complete, curatorial_review_complete, publication_hold and maintenance_replacement, and exact integers -1 through 3 inclusive for age_days. Booleans are forbidden in the integer slot; integers are forbidden in Boolean slots. Other inputs are outside this fixture. Every declared-domain result must have exact Boolean type.
The replacement consists only of the unchanged signature and one return expression. Permitted expressions are input names, Boolean constants, integer literals, parentheses, not, and, or, and same-type comparisons ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=. No calls, imports, attributes, indexing, arithmetic, assignments or other statements. No candidate code is executed: the existing bounded whitelist interpreter treats the expression as data.

Queue eligibility is a fictional predicate. A True result is not permission to publish, move a file or contact anyone. No current patch evaluation, proof or independent acceptance receipt is supplied by these records.
